about: The model library's shipped list (next leaps 43-a, D-43.1). Built from docs/LOCAL-MODELS.md's ladder by memory size. Each entry's Ollama name, download size, context and abilities were read from that model's page on ollama.com/library (the tags list) on the date in `checked`. The size here is the list's own ('about'); the size read from the registry just before a download ('measured') is the one that counts. Cloud-only models (DeepSeek V4 Flash on Ollama) are left out: the library only lists models that run on your own computer. lmstudio is empty until the library can download for LM Studio.
